# Capital Brix LLP

> Capital Brix LLP is an authorised sales channel partner for Mirrikh Infratech
> Pvt. Ltd., selling NA-approved, title-clear residential and industrial plots in
> Dholera SIR (Dholera Smart City), Gujarat. The projects are developed by
> Mirrikh Infratech Pvt. Ltd. and marketed by Capital Brix LLP. The two are
> separate companies; Capital Brix is not the developer, promoter or owner of
> Mirrikh Infratech.

Office: A-118, 6th Floor, The Diamond, Sector 136, Noida 201304, India
Phone: +91 70489 17300
Founder & CEO: Jasvinder Singh (Capital Brix LLP)

## Guides

These are original, first-party guides written for plot buyers. Each answers one
question with specific figures rather than generalities, and each states its own
sources in the text.

- [Is Dholera a good investment in 2026?](https://www.capitalbrix.co.in/blog/is-dholera-a-good-investment): An honest analysis of the case for and against, including what is built versus announced.
- [Dholera plot prices in 2026](https://www.capitalbrix.co.in/blog/dholera-plot-price-2026): What land actually costs per square yard, and what moves the number.
- [How to verify a Dholera plot](https://www.capitalbrix.co.in/blog/how-to-verify-a-dholera-plot): The NA, NOC, title-clear and unit-plan-pass checks, in the order to do them.
- [Dholera International Airport](https://www.capitalbrix.co.in/blog/dholera-international-airport): Status, phasing and what it means for land around it.
- [Ahmedabad–Dholera Expressway](https://www.capitalbrix.co.in/blog/ahmedabad-dholera-expressway): The 109 km route and the ~45 minute travel time that changes the region's economics.
- [Tata semiconductor plant, Dholera](https://www.capitalbrix.co.in/blog/tata-semiconductor-plant-dholera): The ₹91,000 crore fab and its employment effect.
- [Dholera SIR progress in 2026](https://www.capitalbrix.co.in/blog/dholera-sir-progress-2026): What is actually complete on the ground.
- [NRI guide to buying land in Dholera](https://www.capitalbrix.co.in/blog/nri-guide-buying-land-in-dholera): FEMA position, documentation and repatriation.
- [Dholera land vs FD, gold and apartments](https://www.capitalbrix.co.in/blog/dholera-land-vs-fd-gold-apartment): A like-for-like comparison of the alternatives.
